title: A FIRST! Launch of ATTP’s automated national ranking system
excerpt: ATTP proudly announces an unprecedented automated system for calculating the national table tennis player ranking.
body_html:
The National Sports Association ATTP introduces an innovative system for calculating the national table tennis ranking.

On 25 May 2024, the National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players of the Republic of Moldova (ATTP) proudly announced the launch of an unprecedented system for automatically calculating the national ranking of table tennis players. This innovative project promises to transform the way player performance is assessed, ensuring maximum accuracy and transparency.

Key features of the new rating system:

• Maximum precision.

The system is based on advanced algorithms that take into account many factors affecting match results. This is fundamental to an accurate assessment of players’ level and achievements.

• Transparency.

The new system completely removes the so-called “human factor” and subjective assessments, relying solely on real statistical data and match results.

• Regular updates.

The rating will be updated monthly, allowing players to track their progress quickly and unconditionally and to adjust their strategy and training plan.

• Recognition.

The system awards the right number of points for achievements at major national tournaments under the auspices of ATTP and at international ones, encouraging players to take part in prestigious competitions and raise their level of play.

ATTP President Rostislav SOBIEȚKI commented: “Introducing this new, modern rating system is a substantial step forward for our sport and a significant event for everyone who plays it. We are convinced it will make the assessment of our players fair and objective, motivating them towards new achievements and wins.”

The new ranking system will come into force on 1 June 2024, and the results of the first tournaments counted will be published before the end of the month. All players and coaches will be briefed on the details and features of the new system at the next ATTP meeting.

The National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players of the Republic of Moldova invites all interested parties to cooperate and take an active part in developing table tennis in our country.
